harbor_antrieb_executor.summary: Configured node1 (Ubuntu 16.04) to require new user passwords to be at least 12 characters and use at least 3 character classes, via pam_pwquality (libpam-pwquality) wired into /etc/pam.d/common-password with minlen=12, minclass=3, enforce_for_root in /etc/security/pwquality.conf. Verified enforcement pre- and post-reboot with weak/compliant password attempts, then restarted node1 and confirmed boot identity changed and policy persisted.
actions_performed: Inspected OS and existing PAM password stack on node1 (Ubuntu 16.04, no pwquality installed)
Set minlen=12, minclass=3, enforce_for_root in /etc/security/pwquality.conf (backed up original as .bak)
Inserted 'password requisite pam_pwquality.so retry=3' before the pam_unix line in /etc/pam.d/common-password and added use_authtok/try_first_pass to pam_unix (backed up original as .bak)
Created test user pwtestuser and verified: short password rejected, 12+ char/2-class password rejected (minclass), 12+ char/3-class compliant password accepted; removed test user
Captured baseline boot_id and confirmed PAM config in place
Issued 'shutdown -r now' in background so acknowledgement returned before disconnect
Polled node1 until SSH available again; confirmed boot_id changed from fa1e87e6-00f3-42d2-acc5-ad1df6c3d16a to 9a047714-5de2-4f3b-960a-df9d039fe765
Re-verified PAM/pwquality config present after reboot and re-tested weak (rejected) vs compliant (accepted) password changes with fresh test user pwtestuser2; removed test user

evidence.requirement: Password policy enforces minimum 12-char length and 3 character classes on node1
evidence.summary: Baseline PAM/OS inspection, installed libpam-pwquality, set minlen=12/minclass=3/enforce_for_root, wired pam_pwquality into common-password

evidence.requirement: Policy correctly rejects short passwords and passwords with <3 character classes, accepts compliant passwords (pre-reboot functional proof)
evidence.summary: Direct passwd attempts as non-root user: short password rejected, 2-class 12+ char password rejected, compliant 3-class 14-char password accepted (exit 0); test user cleaned up

evidence.requirement: node1 healthy baseline boot identity captured before restart
evidence.summary: Captured boot_id fa1e87e6-00f3-42d2-acc5-ad1df6c3d16a and confirmed PAM/pwquality config present before restart

evidence.requirement: node1 restart acknowledgement returned before disconnect
evidence.summary: Issued 'shutdown -r now' in background; command returned 'reboot-issued' before the node disconnected

evidence.requirement: node1 boot identity changed, proving an actual restart occurred
evidence.summary: SSH connection refused during reboot, then boot_id read as 9a047714-5de2-4f3b-960a-df9d039fe765, differing from the pre-restart value

evidence.requirement: node1 required config and password-policy service recovered and function correctly after restart
evidence.summary: Post-reboot: PAM common-password and pwquality.conf settings intact; live test showed weak password rejected (exit 10) and compliant password accepted (exit 0); test user cleaned up
